# Video2PDF

> Video2PDF is a mobile app for iPhone and Android that turns a handheld video of a physical book, notebook, or handout into a clean, searchable PDF. Full-resolution videos, page images, and PDFs stay on the user's device.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.video2pdf.ai/): Product overview. Film pages in one continuous video and get a straightened, OCR-searchable PDF in seconds. Covers the three-step workflow, the six core features (smart page detection, hand avoidance, perspective correction, adaptive enhancement, searchable OCR text, private by design), pricing, and an FAQ.
- [Start Free Trial](https://www.video2pdf.ai/go): Web checkout for Video2PDF Pro. 3-day free trial, then $29.99 per year with the price locked for life.
- [Manage Subscription](https://www.video2pdf.ai/manage): Self-service portal to update or cancel a Video2PDF Pro subscription purchased on the web.
- [How to Scan a Book With Your Phone](https://www.video2pdf.ai/how-to-scan-a-book): Practical guide to scanning books by filming them: step-by-step technique, the six mistakes that ruin phone scans, an honest comparison of video capture vs photo scanner apps (Adobe Scan, vFlat, CamScanner) vs flatbed scanners, and notes on scanning books you own.
- [About](https://www.video2pdf.ai/about): Who makes Video2PDF (a small independent team, built by students tired of scanning pages one by one), why it exists, and how user data is handled.
- [Video2PDF Alternatives](https://www.video2pdf.ai/alternatives): Honest comparison of Video2PDF with vFlat Scan, Adobe Scan, CamScanner, Scanner Pro, Genius Scan, and retired Microsoft Lens: capture methods, book modes, OCR limits, account requirements, and when each app (or a flatbed scanner) is the better pick.
- [Microsoft Lens Alternatives](https://www.video2pdf.ai/microsoft-lens-alternative): What to use now that Microsoft Lens is retired (2026), organized by job: books and long documents, everyday paperwork, and whiteboards, with honest picks including apps not made by Video2PDF.
- [vFlat Alternative](https://www.video2pdf.ai/vflat-alternative): vFlat Scan vs Video2PDF side by side: photo-per-spread capture vs continuous video, flattening vs speed, OCR quotas, and honest guidance on when vFlat is the better pick.
- [Scanner Apps Without an Account](https://www.video2pdf.ai/scanner-app-no-account): Which scanner apps work with no account or sign-up (Video2PDF, Genius Scan, PDFgear Scan) and which require one (Adobe Scan, CamScanner).

## Legal

- [Privacy Policy](https://www.video2pdf.ai/privacy): How Video2PDF handles data. Cleanup, enhancement, and text recognition run on-device; reduced-resolution copies of sampled frames are sent to Video2PDF's servers for page detection and ordering, then deleted, and are never used to train AI models. Full-resolution videos, page images, and PDFs stay on the device.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.video2pdf.ai/terms): Subscription terms, free trial and cancellation policy, and acceptable use.
- [Delete Your Data](https://www.video2pdf.ai/delete-account): How to delete data associated with Video2PDF.

## Key Facts

- Product: Video2PDF, a consumer mobile app for iPhone and Android by Kaelor Ltd, at video2pdf.ai
- What it does: converts one continuous handheld video of book or notebook pages into a straightened, enhanced, fully searchable PDF, with no tripod and no page-by-page capture
- How it works: the app detects the moment each page settles, skips frames containing fingers, picks the sharpest frame, corrects perspective, enhances contrast, and runs OCR on every page
- Privacy model: full-resolution videos, page images, and PDFs never leave the phone; cleanup, enhancement, and OCR run on-device; only reduced-resolution copies of sampled frames go to Video2PDF's servers for page detection and ordering, then are deleted; no account or sign-up required
- Pricing: Video2PDF Pro costs $29.99 per year after a 3-day free trial; unlimited scans, no watermarks; a weekly plan at $4.99 per week is also available
- Difference from scanner apps: unlike page-at-a-time scanner apps (CamScanner, vFlat, Adobe Scan), Video2PDF captures pages from continuous video while you flip through the book
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/video2pdf/id6761927204
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.vid2pdf.app
- Not affiliated with: video2pdf.com, the video2pdf packages on PyPI or GitHub (video-slides-to-PDF converters), or "Video to PDF Converter AI" transcription apps
- Typical users: students digitizing textbooks and lecture notes, teachers capturing worksheets, researchers archiving printed material
